q: What is the term for the breakdown of food into smaller components?
e: Term for the breakdown of food into smaller components is Digestion. Digestion breaks food into small molecules the body can absorb. Absorption is a different claim from Digestion.

q: Which of the following describes the process of absorption?
e: Transporting nutrients into cells is the one that describes the process of absorption. The cell is the basic unit of structure and function in living organisms. Taking in food is a different claim from Transporting nutrients into cells.

e: Metabolism is the sum of all chemical reactions in the body. The sum of all chemical reactions in the body is the idea that completes this fact. The absorption of nutrients is a different claim from The sum of all chemical reactions in the body.

q: Which organ is responsible for detoxifying harmful substances in the body?
e: Liver is organ is responsible for detoxifying harmful substances in the body. Liver is the idea that completes this fact. Pancreas is a different claim from Liver.

q: What is the primary function of the kidneys?
e: Primary function of the kidneys is Filter blood. Filter blood is the idea that completes this fact. Digest food is a different claim from Filter blood.

q: What is the role of the liver in digestion?
e: Role of the liver in digestion is Store glucose. Store glucose is the idea that completes this fact. Absorb nutrients is a different claim from Store glucose.

q: Which of the following is a function of the digestive system?
e: Nutrient absorption is a function of the digestive system. Nutrient absorption is the idea that completes this fact. Hormone production is not a function of the digestive system.

q: What is the main waste product of protein metabolism?
e: Main waste product of protein metabolism is Urea. Urea is the idea that completes this fact. Lactate is a different claim from Urea.

q: What is the role of the gallbladder?

q: What is the primary energy source for the brain?
